summary: Double murder conviction and death sentence challenged; issues of fair trial under Article 21; compliance with Cr.P.C. procedural guarantees; post-mortem findings indicate multiple ante mortem injuries on victims; prosecution case based on circumstantial evidence; lapses in investigation and trial affecting reliability; conviction and sentence subject to re-evaluation due to material irregularities; references to precedents on fair investigation and fair trial jurisprudence.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; matter remanded for fresh consideration in accordance with law.
